requirements.title: Stable product identity
requirements.statement: Product identity remains stable across repository rename, alias, transport, and UI representation.
requirements.positive: Represent one product through two aliases/transports; both resolve to one ProductId and prior observations remain addressable.
requirements.negative: A repository rename must not create a second product identity or orphan prior observations.

requirements.title: Accepted baseline immutability
requirements.statement: Changing accepted product intent creates a distinct accepted baseline revision through an explicit change workflow; prior accepted revisions remain unchanged.
requirements.positive: Accept a baseline, accept a proposal changing intent, and observe a later revision while the prior revision remains queryable unchanged.
requirements.negative: Draft/rejected proposals or in-place edits must not alter an accepted baseline.

requirements.title: Typed accepted intent
requirements.statement: Accepted intent distinguishes requirements, obligations, capabilities, and measurable targets and retains lifecycle status.
requirements.positive: Persist/retrieve each intent kind and lifecycle status at the exact baseline.
requirements.negative: Do not collapse all intent into an untyped description or erase deferred/retired history.

requirements.title: Observation scope binding
requirements.statement: Every observation binds to an exact product and baseline; capability-scoped observations also bind to the intended capability.
requirements.positive: Evidence for product A/baseline 1 affects only that assessment.
requirements.negative: Evidence from another product, baseline, or capability must not change the target assessment.

requirements.title: Observation provenance
requirements.statement: Observations retain collector identity/version, recording time, result, and source artifact reference when available.
requirements.positive: Retrieve an observation and explain who/what produced it and from which artifact.
requirements.negative: A bare pass/fail with no attributable producer must not be treated as equivalent evidence.

requirements.title: Append-only observations
requirements.statement: Recording later observations does not mutate accepted intent or rewrite earlier observations.
requirements.positive: Append a later observation and confirm the prior observation and baseline remain unchanged/addressable.
requirements.negative: Updating an old failure in place to become a pass is prohibited.

requirements.title: Truthful assessment states
requirements.statement: Assessment distinguishes satisfied, violated, stale, unknown, and inconclusive according to admissible evidence.
requirements.positive: Passing, failing, absent, stale, and conflicting fixtures produce distinct expected states.
requirements.negative: Unknown, stale, missing, or conflicting proof must never fall through to Satisfied.

requirements.title: Deterministic assessment
requirements.statement: Identical accepted intent, observations, baseline, evaluation time, and configuration produce the same assessment and explanation.
requirements.positive: Run a fixed fixture twice and compare status/counts/findings.
requirements.negative: Uncontrolled wall-clock or unrelated observations must not alter the same scoped fixture.

requirements.title: Missing proof is not success
requirements.statement: Required accepted intent without admissible proof evaluates to an explicit non-green state.
requirements.positive: Assess accepted required intent with zero qualifying observations and receive Unknown/non-green with explanation.
requirements.negative: Empty observations or empty selected checks returning Satisfied is prohibited.

requirements.title: Conflicting proof is explicit
requirements.statement: Conflicting admissible evidence is represented as inconclusive/contradictory rather than arbitrarily selecting green.
requirements.positive: Contemporaneous qualifying pass+fail evidence yields a non-green conflict state/finding.
requirements.negative: Last-write-wins selection of a pass while hiding a failure is prohibited.

requirements.title: Freshness dissatisfaction
requirements.statement: Tracera identifies accepted capabilities whose available evidence exceeds the configured freshness threshold and explains the stale source.
requirements.positive: An old qualifying observation produces a freshness finding tied to product/capability/baseline/source.
requirements.negative: Collector absence is missing/unknown, not fabricated stale evidence.

requirements.title: Coverage dissatisfaction
requirements.statement: Tracera identifies accepted capabilities lacking qualifying observations without overstating the claim beyond missing proof.
requirements.positive: Accepted capability with no qualifying observation produces a coverage/missing-proof finding.
requirements.negative: A capability with qualifying proof must not receive the finding because unrelated evidence is absent.

requirements.title: Contradiction dissatisfaction
requirements.statement: Tracera detects contradictory passed/failed observations scoped to the same accepted capability and baseline and preserves both sources.
requirements.positive: Qualifying pass+fail observations produce an explainable contradiction finding.
requirements.negative: Observations from different products/baselines must not be combined into a contradiction.

requirements.title: Product intent graph distinct from evidence graph
requirements.statement: Product/capability/obligation/target concepts and typed relations are represented separately from engineering evidence while explicit links can connect the layers.
requirements.positive: Create/query product-intent relations then traverse an explicit link to supporting engineering evidence.
requirements.negative: Encoding product identity only as a generic SWEE requirement/work item is insufficient.

requirements.title: Proposal without accepted-state mutation
requirements.statement: A proposal records intended graph/baseline change without directly applying it to accepted product truth.
requirements.positive: Submit proposal; accepted baseline remains unchanged until authorized acceptance.
requirements.negative: Calling propose must not mutate accepted intent as a side effect.
